name: Rosette
description: John Whitney Sr.'s Arabesque (1975) morphing emblem: a two-term epicycle z(t)=e^{it}+a*e^{-i(n-1)t} (n=5) drawn as a single closed white-to-pale-lavender stroke with soft halation on a near-black ground, tightening into a straight-edged pentagon and unravelling into an open tangle. Mirrored coloured wing arcs with small ellipses at the frame edges (D-217: full cartouche). Clock-driven this increment; the harmony coupling (WHIT.1d) will set the morph position from tonalConsonance. See docs/presets/ROSETTE_DESIGN.md and docs/ENGINEERING_PLAN.md Phase WHIT.
author: Matt
